# ShareBounds — the survivor share falls like one over the logarithm

**Generated file — do not edit.** Regenerated by `python scripts/graph.py`.

**Status:** proved in Lean

With the wheels below a bound, the surviving share of the cycle is at most one over the logarithm of the bound, and the twin share is at most twice the square of that. Checked numerically beforehand for wheels up to 200,000; the share times the logarithm approaches 0.5615, the constant in MertensThird.

## Published sources

Published work this node rests on or relates to; each entry says how.

- [Mertens' theorems (Wikipedia)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mertens%27_theorems) — Mertens' third theorem gives the limit 0.5615 that the survivor share times the logarithm approaches
- [J. B. Rosser and L. Schoenfeld, Approximate formulas for some functions of prime numbers, Illinois J. Math. 6 (1962), 64-94](https://projecteuclid.org/download/pdf_1/euclid.ijm/1255631807) — a sharper explicit bound of the same kind, proved analytically; this node's bound is weaker and proved directly

## Claims

<a id="survivor_share_le_inv_log"></a>
### `survivor_share_le_inv_log`

With the wheels below a bound, the surviving share is at most one over the logarithm of the bound.

```lean
/-- **The survivor share is at most one over the logarithm.** For the wheels
below `limit` (at least 2), the survivors of the pattern `{0}` as a share of
the cycle length are at most one over the logarithm of `limit`. -/
def survivor_share_le_inv_log : Prop :=
  ∀ limit : Nat, 2 ≤ limit →
    ((wheel_survivors_gen {0} limit).card : Real) / (primorial_modulus limit : Real)
      ≤ 1 / Real.log limit
```

**Rests on:** [`SurvivorCount.general_survivor_count`](SurvivorCount.md#general_survivor_count)

**Proof:** `RNS.ShareBounds.survivor_share_le_inv_log_step` in [`RNSSolutions/ShareBounds.lean`](../../RNSSolutions/ShareBounds.lean); joined to its inputs in [`RNSSolutions/Assemble.lean`](../../RNSSolutions/Assemble.lean)

<a id="twin_share_le_two_inv_log_sq"></a>
### `twin_share_le_two_inv_log_sq`

The twin share is at most twice the square of one over the logarithm of the bound.

```lean
/-- **The twin share is at most twice the square of that.** For the wheels
below `limit` (at least 2), the survivors of the twin pattern as a share of
the cycle length are at most twice the square of one over the logarithm of
`limit`. -/
def twin_share_le_two_inv_log_sq : Prop :=
  ∀ limit : Nat, 2 ≤ limit →
    ((wheel_survivors limit).card : Real) / (primorial_modulus limit : Real)
      ≤ 2 * (1 / Real.log limit) ^ 2
```

**Rests on:** [`SurvivorCount.twin_survivor_count`](SurvivorCount.md#twin_survivor_count), [`SurvivorCount.general_survivor_count`](SurvivorCount.md#general_survivor_count)

**Proof:** `RNS.ShareBounds.twin_share_le_two_inv_log_sq_step` in [`RNSSolutions/ShareBounds.lean`](../../RNSSolutions/ShareBounds.lean); joined to its inputs in [`RNSSolutions/Assemble.lean`](../../RNSSolutions/Assemble.lean)
